title: Randomized Evaluation of an Autoimmune Disease Prediction Model — AURA (AUtoimmune Risk Assessment)

summary: 单家学术医疗系统将可解释的自身免疫病预测模型嵌入电子病历，开展为期2年的随机实用性研究，评估其对确诊时间的影响。

reason: 前瞻性随机设计并报告诊断时间结局，属重要档；仅单中心实施，未上探里程碑档
abstract: BACKGROUND: No evidence-based guidance exists for triaging individuals with positive antinuclear antibody (ANA) tests for rheumatology referral. We developed and deployed an interpretable clinical prediction model to predict which individuals with incident positive ANA tests will develop systemic autoimmune disease and evaluated its effect on time to autoimmune disease diagnosis in a 2-year randomized pragmatic study. METHODS: The model was integrated into the electronic health record (EHR) at a single academic health system. All ANA-positive individuals were randomly assigned 1:1 independently of risk scores. In the intervention group, individuals with high-risk scores were invited for expedited rheumatology evaluation. In the control group, risk scores were calculated but not acted on. All participants received standard of care and could be referred to rheumatology. Chart reviews every 6 months assessed whether patients had undergone rheumatology evaluation and received a diagnosis of autoimmune disease. The primary outcome, time from positive ANA test to diagnosis, was analyzed using a Cox proportional-hazards model. Among individuals evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of the positive ANA, the proportion diagnosed with an autoimmune disease was compared between study groups. RESULTS: Of 2385 randomly assigned individuals, 954 were analyzed in the intervention group and 1006 in the control group after postrandomization exclusions. Individuals in the intervention group had a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis from the date of positive ANA (hazard ratio, 1.9; 95% confidence interval, 1.3 to 2.7; P<0.001). Among individuals diagnosed with an autoimmune disease, the median time to diagnosis was 43 days in the intervention group and 138 days in the control group. Among those evaluated by rheumatology within 6 months of a positive ANA test, 23% in the intervention group and 16% in the control group were diagnosed with an autoimmune disease (P=0.07). CONCLUSIONS: In this randomized pragmatic study, the intervention incorporating the clinical prediction model was associated with a significantly shorter time to autoimmune disease diagnosis. (Funded by the National Institutes of Health and others.).
zh_abstract: 【背景】对于抗核抗体（ANA）检测阳性个体如何进行风湿科转诊分诊，目前尚无循证指导。我们开发并部署了一个可解释的临床预测模型，用于预测哪些新发 ANA 阳性检测个体将发生系统性自身免疫病，并在一项为期 2 年的随机实用性研究中评估其对自身免疫病诊断时间的影响。【方法】该模型被整合到单一学术卫生系统的电子健康记录（EHR）中。所有 ANA 阳性个体均按 1:1 随机分组，且分组独立于风险评分。在干预组中，高风险评分个体被邀请接受加快的风湿科评估。在对照组中，风险评分被计算但不据此采取措施。所有参与者均接受标准治疗，并可转诊至风湿科。每 6 个月进行病历审查，评估患者是否接受过风湿科评估以及是否获得自身免疫病诊断。主要结局为从 ANA 阳性检测至诊断的时间，采用 Cox 比例风险模型进行分析。在 ANA 阳性后 6 个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，比较研究组间被诊断为自身免疫病的比例。【结果】在 2385 名随机分组个体中，随机化后排除后，干预组 954 人和对照组 1006 人被纳入分析。干预组个体从 ANA 阳性日期起至自身免疫病诊断的时间显著更短（风险比，1.9；95% 置信区间，1.3 至 2.7；P<0.001）。在被诊断为自身免疫病的个体中，干预组的中位诊断时间为 43 天，对照组为 138 天。在 ANA 阳性检测后 6 个月内接受风湿科评估的个体中，干预组 23% 和对照组 16% 被诊断为自身免疫病（P=0.07）。【结论】在这项随机实用性研究中，纳入临床预测模型的干预与显著更短的自身免疫病诊断时间相关。（由美国国立卫生研究院等资助。）

title: Deep learning-based detection and classification of airway nodules on CT for early medical intervention.
zh_title: 深度学习检测与分类CT气道结节
summary: 回顾性研究构建深度学习模型检测低剂量CT气道结节，并在四家医院独立外部测试。

reason: 四院独立外部验证且样本可观，但为回顾性、无临床结局，属重要档下限
abstract: [Insights into imaging] Airway lesions are common CT findings in interval and post-screen lung cancers; however, airway nodules are frequently overlooked. Robust artificial intelligence (AI) tools for characterizing airway nodules remain limited. This study aimed to develop and evaluate deep learning-based models for the detection and classification of airway nodules on low-dose CT(LDCT) as a second-reading tool. 1813 segmental and more proximal airway nodules were retrospectively identified from 1107 LDCT of 1043 participants. A sphere-based center-points matching network, first used to establish a lung nodule detection model, was transferred to airway nodules and enhanced by incorporating coordinate and multiscale attention. The model was trained on 907 proximal airway nodules and independently tested on 738 proximal nodules across four hospitals. The clinical utility of the AI tool was evaluated through human-AI interaction. For nodule classification, a 3D SEResNeXt101-based model was trained, validated and tested using 286 airway nodules (121 benign, 165 malignant) with a 6:2:2 split and evaluated in an independent testing dataset. On the independent testing set, the detection model achieved a high sensitivity of 73.7%. Human-AI interaction demonstrated AI assistance significantly improved radiologists' performance, increasing sensitivity from 39.5% to 72.9% and F1-score from 49.4% to 77.2%, while reducing diagnosis time from 83.8 s to 61.8 s. The classification model showed high sensitivities of 82.1%, 71.4%, 94.3%, 72.7% and specificities of 62.7%, 73.9%, 73.9%, 87.5% across multicenter training, validation, testing and independent testing sets, respectively. This AI system significantly enhances the detection and classification of proximal airway nodules, guiding early medical intervention. Question Improved early detection and classification of airway nodules are critical for lung cancer mortality reduction, but AI-based CAD systems targeting airway nodules remain scarce. Findings The DL models for detection and classification of proximal airway nodules on chest CT were developed and assisted radiologists to achieve higher detection accuracy. Critical Relevance Statement The clinical applications of the proposed DL-based system for detecting and classifying proximal airway nodules on chest CT scans help radiologists reduce missed/delayed diagnoses and shorten diagnostic time as a second-reading tool, guiding medical intervention and improving clinical outcomes.
zh_abstract: [Insights into imaging] 气道病变是间期肺癌和筛查后肺癌中常见的 CT 表现；然而，气道结节常被忽视。用于表征气道结节的稳健人工智能（AI）工具仍然有限。本研究旨在开发并评估基于深度学习的模型，用于在低剂量 CT（LDCT）上检测和分类气道结节，作为二次阅片工具。回顾性从 1043 名参与者的 1107 次 LDCT 中识别出 1813 个段级及更近端气道结节。一个基于球体的中心点匹配网络最初用于建立肺结节检测模型，随后被迁移至气道结节，并通过纳入坐标注意力和多尺度注意力进行增强。该模型在 907 个近端气道结节上训练，并在四家医院的 738 个近端结节上独立测试。通过人机交互评估了该 AI 工具的临床效用。对于结节分类，使用 286 个气道结节（121 个良性、165 个恶性）按 6:2:2 划分训练、验证和测试了一个基于 3D SEResNeXt101 的模型，并在独立测试数据集中进行评估。在独立测试集上，检测模型达到 73.7% 的高灵敏度。人机交互表明，AI 辅助显著提高了放射科医生的表现，将灵敏度从 39.5% 提高到 72.9%，F1 分数从 49.4% 提高到 77.2%，同时将诊断时间从 83.8 秒缩短至 61.8 秒。该分类模型在多中心训练、验证、测试和独立测试集上分别显示出 82.1%、71.4%、94.3%、72.7% 的高灵敏度和 62.7%、73.9%、73.9%、87.5% 的特异度。该系统显著增强近端气道结节的检测和分类，指导早期医疗干预。【问题】改善气道结节的早期检测和分类对于降低肺癌死亡率至关重要，但针对气道结节的基于 AI 的 CAD 系统仍然稀缺。【发现】开发了用于胸部 CT 上近端气道结节检测和分类的深度学习（DL）模型，并帮助放射科医生实现更高的检测准确率。【关键相关性声明】所提出的基于 DL 的系统在胸部 CT 扫描上检测和分类近端气道结节的临床应用，有助于放射科医生作为二次阅片工具减少漏诊/延迟诊断并缩短诊断时间，指导医疗干预并改善临床结局。

title: AI-based precision prognostics and therapy personalization for childhood brain tumors.

abstract: [Nature genetics] Accurate prediction of patient outcomes remains a critical challenge in oncology, in particular for childhood brain tumors, in which treatment decisions need to carefully balance risk of tumor recurrence and death against severe therapy-induced sequelae. Here, we developed MANTIS (methylation profiling and artificial neural networks for time-dependent individualized survival predictions), a precision artificial intelligence (AI) tool for medulloblastoma and ependymoma outcome prediction built on genome-wide DNA methylation array data from 2,786 patients. MANTIS generates individualized survival probabilities over a 10-year period and achieves concordance indices as high as 0.80 ± 0.07, significantly exceeding the predictive accuracy of current clinical indicators. Extending MANTIS to estimate individualized treatment effects identifies ~60% of patients with average-risk medulloblastoma without a significant survival disadvantage (P = 0.683) when treated with less intensive craniospinal irradiation doses, which is associated with improved neurocognitive outcomes. In conclusion, our study establishes a foundation for AI-based precision prognostics and therapy personalization in childhood brain tumors and offers a blueprint for similar initiatives in other cancer types.
zh_abstract: ［Nature genetics］准确预测患者结局仍是肿瘤学中的关键挑战，尤其是儿童脑肿瘤，其治疗决策需要仔细权衡肿瘤复发和死亡风险与严重治疗诱导的后遗症。在此，我们开发了MANTIS（methylation profiling and artificial neural networks for time-dependent individualized survival predictions；甲基化谱分析和人工神经网络用于时间依赖性个体化生存预测），一种用于髓母细胞瘤和室管膜瘤结局预测的精准人工智能（AI）工具，基于2,786例患者全基因组DNA甲基化芯片数据构建。MANTIS生成10年期间的个体化生存概率，一致性指数高达0.80 ± 0.07，显著超过当前临床指标的预测准确性。将MANTIS扩展以估计个体化治疗效应，识别出约60%的平均风险髓母细胞瘤患者在接受较低强度颅脊髓照射剂量治疗时无显著生存劣势（P = 0.683），而较低强度颅脊髓照射剂量与神经认知结局改善相关。总之，我们的研究为儿童脑肿瘤基于AI的精准预后和治疗个体化奠定了基础，并为其他癌症类型的类似计划提供了蓝图。

title: MambaSleepCVD for prediction of long term cardiovascular outcomes from polysomnography

summary: 基于 Coupled Mamba 的多模态融合模型，在 SHHS 队列上用整夜多导睡眠图预测长期心血管风险。

abstract: Long-term cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk prediction remains a major global clinical priority. This study investigates how much prognostic information full-night polysomnography (PSG) carries after explicitly controlling demographic confounding, and whether combining specialized unimodal representations with continuous fusion mechanisms can effectively leverage it. We adopt a modular framework based on Coupled Mamba for simultaneous cross-modal and temporal fusion, capturing long-range dependencies and dynamic interactions between physiological modalities throughout sleep. With this capability, we assess whether specialized supervised representations from task-specific unimodal encoders offer prognostic value comparable to task-agnostic multimodal self-supervised pre-training. Validated on the Sleep Heart Health Study (SHHS) dataset, our approach achieves performance comparable to or better than current state-of-the-art architectures in the fully supervised, data-abundant regime, although the cardiac channel alone accounts for most of the discriminative signal. More importantly, we show that in the reference dataset chronological age strongly drives survival ranking; when provided as an explicit input, it can create a shortcut that obscures the contribution of PSG-derived physiology. Ultimately, our findings suggest that supervised unimodal experts integrated through a fusion engine provide a flexible pathway for prognostic risk ranking from sleep recordings, while reliable CVD screening will require independent external cohorts and explicit confounder control.
zh_abstract: 长期心血管疾病（CVD）风险预测仍是全球重大临床优先事项。本研究探讨在明确控制人口学混杂因素后，整夜多导睡眠图（PSG）携带多少预后信息，以及将专门化的单模态表征与连续融合机制相结合能否有效利用这些信息。我们采用基于 Coupled Mamba 的模块化框架，同时进行跨模态和时间融合，捕捉整个睡眠过程中生理模态之间的长程依赖和动态交互。借助这一能力，我们评估来自任务特定单模态编码器的专门化监督表征是否提供与任务无关的多模态自监督预训练相当的预后价值。在睡眠心脏健康研究（SHHS）数据集上验证，我们的方法在完全监督、数据充足的情形下达到与当前最先进架构相当或更好的性能，尽管仅心脏通道就贡献了大部分判别信号。更重要的是，我们表明在参考数据集中，实际年龄强烈驱动生存排名；当作为显式输入提供时，它可能形成一条捷径，掩盖 PSG 衍生生理信息的贡献。最终，我们的发现表明，通过融合引擎整合的监督单模态专家为从睡眠记录中进行预后风险排序提供了一条灵活途径，而可靠的 CVD 筛查将需要独立外部队列和明确的混杂因素控制。

abstract: [Journal of dentistry] To critically evaluate the current role of artificial intelligence (AI) in dental diagnosis across multiple dental disciplines, assessing diagnostic performance, methodological quality, risk of bias, validation, explainability, and clinical applicability. This systematic review was conducted in accordance with PRISMA guidelines and registered in PROSPERO (CRD42025639340). PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, LILACS, Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Web of Science, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched up to December-2025. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment. Risk of bias in diagnostic accuracy studies was assessed using QUADAS-2-tool, evaluating the domains of patient selection, index test, reference standard, flow and timing whilst randomised studies were assessed using Cochrane RoB 2-tool. Reporting quality and transparency of AI-model development and validation were assessed using the selected items from TRIPOD-AI reporting guideline. Methodological quality and risk of bias in AI model development and evaluation were additionally assessed using PROBAST+AI. Ninety-six studies met the inclusion criteria, of which 90.6% were retrospective. Convolutional neural networks (CNN) were the most frequently used architecture (82.3%). Sixteen studies failed to specify the CNN architecture used. Reported diagnostic accuracy ranged from 81% to 99% across dental specialties, with high performance in implantology (92-99%), orthodontics (88-99%), endodontics (87-99%). Panoramic radiographs and cone-beam computed tomography were the most used imaging modalities. QUADAS-2 analysis indicated that high-risk of bias in 55.2% of studies and most lacked external validation, whilst Assessment using selected TRIPOD+AI items identified important gaps in reporting completeness and transparency, particularly in sample-size justification, missing-data handling, protocol availability, study registration, and data or code availability. AI demonstrates substantial technical capability to enhance diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. However, the predominance of retrospective designs, limited external validation, and methodological weaknesses constrain the strength of current evidence. The use of AI is potentially considered as a decision-support tool rather than replacement for clinical judgement.
zh_abstract: [Journal of dentistry] 严格评价人工智能（AI）在多个牙科专业牙科诊断中的当前作用，评估诊断性能、方法学质量、偏倚风险、验证、可解释性和临床适用性。本系统综述按照PRISMA指南进行，并在PROSPERO注册（CRD42025639340）。检索PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Embase、LILACS、Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials、Web of Science和ClinicalTrials.gov，截至2025年12月。两名评价者独立进行研究选择、数据提取和偏倚风险评估。诊断准确性研究中的偏倚风险使用QUADAS-2工具评估，评价患者选择、指标试验、参考标准、流程和时间领域；随机研究则使用Cochrane RoB 2工具评估。AI模型开发和验证的报告质量与透明度使用TRIPOD-AI报告指南中的选定条目评估。AI模型开发与评价的方法学质量和偏倚风险额外使用PROBAST+AI评估。96项研究符合纳入标准，其中90.6%为回顾性研究。卷积神经网络（CNN）是最常用的架构（82.3%）。16项研究未说明所使用的CNN架构。各牙科专业报告的诊断准确率范围为81%至99%，在口腔种植学（92-99%）、口腔正畸学（88-99%）、牙髓病学（87-99%）中表现较高。全景X线片和锥形束计算机断层扫描是最常用的成像方式。QUADAS-2分析表明55.2%的研究存在高偏倚风险，且大多数缺乏外部验证；而使用选定的TRIPOD+AI条目进行评估发现，在报告完整性和透明度方面存在重要缺口，尤其是在样本量论证、缺失数据处理、方案可获取性、研究注册以及数据或代码可获取性方面。AI在提高诊断准确性和效率方面展现出相当大的技术能力。然而，回顾性设计占主导、外部验证有限以及方法学弱点限制了当前证据的强度。AI的使用可能被视为一种决策支持工具，而非临床判断的替代。

abstract: [World journal of urology] To evaluate pooled performance of artificial intelligence (AI) in computed tomography (CT)-based urinary stone detection and classification and identify methodological factors influencing results. This review was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261319940). A systematic search of PubMed, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar was conducted up to March 15, 2026. Studies evaluating AI-based detection or classification of urolithiasis on CT with available validation/test cohort data (sensitivity/specificity or 2 × 2 tables) were included. A bivariate random-effects model generated pooled sensitivity, specificity, and hierarchical summary receiver operating characteristic (HSROC) curves. Meta-regression explored moderators related to dataset composition and AI pipelines. Risk of bias was assessed using QUADAS-AI. 14 studies (five detection-based, nine classification-based) were included. Overall pooled sensitivity and specificity were 0.967 and 0.979 (AUC 0.987). Classification studies demonstrated higher pooled sensitivity (0.977) and specificity (0.990) compared with detection studies (0.935 and 0.919; AUC 0.945). Significant heterogeneity was observed and influenced by training sample size, class imbalance, presence of bladder stones or other pathologies, and architectural choices. Most studies had high risk of bias, lacked external validation, and frequently used slice-level or pre-selected datasets, potentially overestimating performance. Substantial methodological heterogeneity and high risk of bias limit clinical generalizability. Detection studies better reflect real-world workflows and show lower performance. Current evidence does not support routine clinical implementation without standardized reporting and robust external validation.

title: Evaluation of large language models for guideline-based clinical questions in muscle-invasive and non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer and upper tract urothelial carcinoma: a multidisciplinary Delphi study.
source: PubMed · Journal of comparative effectiveness research

summary: 将2025 EAU指南输入Claude、Gemini、ChatGPT，各实体25题，由7–10人专家组两轮Delphi评分。
key_points: 覆盖NMIBC、MIBC与UTUC三类疾病
各模型一致同意率88%、100%、96%
以9分制评分，中位分≥7为达标
reason: 多模型对比加多学科专家评分，设计规范，但题量有限、无真实临床结局
abstract: [Journal of comparative effectiveness research] Aim: To assess expert panel agreement with responses from three large language models, Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, to questions based on guidelines for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC), muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) and upper tract urothelial carcinoma (UTUC). Materials & methods: The 2025 European Association of Urology (EAU) guidelines were provided to Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.5 Flash and GPT-4.1-mini. Figures and tables were converted into plain language text. Each model answered 25 questions per entity. Panels of 7-10 experts rated responses on a 9-point scale using a modified Delphi process with two rounds. Outcomes were consensus in agreement and median expert panel score ≥7. Results: For Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, respectively, consensus in agreement was achieved for 88%, 100% and 96% of NMIBC responses (p = 0.097); 92%, 100% and 96% of MIBC responses (p = 0.223); and 56%, 100% and 96% of UTUC responses (p < 0.001). For UTUC, significantly fewer Claude responses achieved consensus in agreement than Gemini or ChatGPT responses. Across all questions, consensus in agreement was achieved for 59/75 Claude responses (78.7%), 75/75 Gemini responses (100%), and 72/75 ChatGPT responses (96%) (p < 0.001). Median scores ≥7 were achieved for 88%, 100% and 100% of NMIBC responses; 96%, 100% and 100% of MIBC responses; and 68%, 100% and 96% of UTUC responses. In UTUC, Claude had significantly fewer such responses than Gemini, but the difference from ChatGPT was not statistically significant. Overall, median scores ≥7 were achieved for 63/75 Claude responses (84%), 75/75 Gemini responses (100%) and 74/75 ChatGPT responses (98.7%) (p < 0.001). Conclusion: Under the study conditions, large language model responses frequently achieved expert panel agreement, particularly for Gemini and ChatGPT, supporting the potential of these models for guideline interpretation. Further validation is required to establish clinical utility and safety.
zh_abstract: [Journal of comparative effectiveness research] 【目的】评估专家小组对三种大型语言模型Claude、Gemini和ChatGPT针对非肌层浸润性膀胱癌（NMIBC）、肌层浸润性膀胱癌（MIBC）和上尿路尿路上皮癌（UTUC）指南问题所作回答的一致性。 【材料与方法】向Claude 3.5 Haiku、Gemini 2.5 Flash和GPT-4.1-mini提供2025年欧洲泌尿外科学会（EAU）指南。图和表被转换为通俗语言文本。每个模型对每种疾病实体回答25个问题。由7-10名专家组成的小组使用改良德尔菲法分两轮对回答按9分制评分。结局为一致性共识和专家小组评分中位数≥7。 【结果】对于Claude、Gemini和ChatGPT，分别有88%、100%和96%的NMIBC回答达成一致性共识（p = 0.097）；92%、100%和96%的MIBC回答达成一致性共识（p = 0.223）；56%、100%和96%的UTUC回答达成一致性共识（p < 0.001）。对于UTUC，Claude回答达成一致性共识的数量显著少于Gemini或ChatGPT回答。在所有问题中，Claude回答有59/75（78.7%）、Gemini回答有75/75（100%）、ChatGPT回答有72/75（96%）达成一致性共识（p < 0.001）。中位评分≥7的比例分别为：NMIBC回答88%、100%和100%；MIBC回答96%、100%和100%；UTUC回答68%、100%和96%。在UTUC中，Claude此类回答显著少于Gemini，但与ChatGPT的差异无统计学意义。总体而言，Claude回答有63/75（84%）、Gemini回答有75/75（100%）、ChatGPT回答有74/75（98.7%）达到中位评分≥7（p < 0.001）。 【结论】在本研究条件下，大型语言模型的回答经常获得专家小组一致性认可，尤其是Gemini和ChatGPT，支持这些模型用于指南解读的潜力。尚需进一步验证以确立临床效用和安全性。

title: Performance of intraoperative artificial intelligence-assisted label-free stimulated Raman histology in recurrent brain tumors.
zh_title: 术中AI辅助无标记拉曼组学用于复发脑肿瘤
summary: 双中心观察性研究显示，光纤激光刺激拉曼组学联合卷积神经网络可在术中快速检测与分型复发中枢神经系统肿瘤。
key_points: 双中心观察性研究，纳入143例患者共262幅SRH图像
CNN2行组织学分型，对照最终整合病理诊断
reason: 双中心外部对照验证，但样本143例且仅报告诊断准确性，属值得一看档
abstract: [Neuro-oncology advances] Therapy-induced tissue alterations complicate intraoperative diagnosis of recurrent central nervous system (CNS) tumors. We evaluated stimulated Raman histology (SRH) combined with convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for rapid tumor detection and classification. In this bicentric observational study, fresh tissue from patients undergoing resection or stereotactic biopsy for suspected recurrent CNS tumors was imaged with fiber-laser-based SRH. CNN1 performed binary tumor/non-tumor prediction and CNN2 histotype classification. CNN1 was evaluated against blinded neuropathologist SRH consensus and CNN2 against the final integrated histopathological diagnosis. Of 382 acquired SRH images, 262 images from 143 patients were included. CNN1 achieved an AUC of 0.975 (95% CI, 0.95-1.00) for tumor detection. An exploratory cohort-derived tumor probability threshold of ≥59 increased specificity from 70.7% to 92.0% while maintaining 95.2% sensitivity and identifying 71.4% of radiation necrosis samples. Among 212 images in treatment subgroup analysis, CNN1 accuracy did not differ significantly across prior-treatment groups (overall 90.1%; P = .080). CNN2 accuracy declined from 61.8% after surgery alone to 39.0% after surgery, radiotherapy, and medical treatment (χ2 = 6.04, P = .049). Multimodal therapy was independently associated with lower odds of correct CNN2 prediction (adjusted OR, 0.10 [95% CI, 0.02-0.39]; P = .001 and 0.04 [95% CI, 0.01-0.20]; P < .001). 120/382 images (31.4%) were of insufficient diagnostic quality; application of the quality control threshold would have rejected 84/120 (70.0%). CNN1 maintained high tumor/non-tumor discrimination across treatment subgroups when image quality was sufficient, whereas CNN2 entity-classification performance declined with increasing treatment intensity. Reliable SRH-based diagnosis in recurrent tumors requires validated image-quality control measures and model adaptation to recurrent disease.
zh_abstract: [Neuro-oncology advances] 治疗诱导的组织改变使复发性中枢神经系统（CNS）肿瘤的术中诊断复杂化。我们评估了刺激拉曼组织学（SRH）联合卷积神经网络（CNN）用于快速肿瘤检测和分类。在这项双中心观察性研究中，对因疑似复发性CNS肿瘤接受切除或立体定向活检患者的新鲜组织，采用基于光纤激光的SRH进行成像。CNN1进行二分类的肿瘤/非肿瘤预测，CNN2进行组织学亚型分类。CNN1以盲法神经病理学家SRH共识为参照进行评估，CNN2以最终整合组织病理学诊断为参照进行评估。在获取的382幅SRH图像中，纳入来自143例患者的262幅图像。CNN1用于肿瘤检测的AUC为0.975（95% CI，0.95-1.00）。源自探索性队列的肿瘤概率阈值≥59将特异性从70.7%提高至92.0%，同时维持95.2%的敏感性，并识别出71.4%的放射性坏死样本。在治疗亚组分析中的212幅图像中，CNN1准确率在既往治疗组间无显著差异（总体90.1%；P = .080）。CNN2准确率从仅手术后的61.8%下降至手术、放疗和药物治疗后的39.0%（χ2 = 6.04，P = .049）。多模式治疗与CNN2正确预测的较低几率独立相关（校正OR，0.10 [95% CI，0.02-0.39]；P = .001，以及0.04 [95% CI，0.01-0.20]；P < .001）。120/382幅图像（31.4%）诊断质量不足；应用质量控制阈值本可拒绝84/120幅（70.0%）。当图像质量足够时，CNN1在各治疗亚组中维持较高的肿瘤/非肿瘤判别能力，而CNN2的实体分类性能随治疗强度增加而下降。复发性肿瘤中可靠的基于SRH的诊断需要经过验证的图像质量控制措施以及模型对复发性疾病的适配。

title: Unimodal imaging foundation models and vision-language models in MRI: A systematic review of emerging methods and clinical applications.
zh_title: MRI 单模态基础模型与视觉语言模型系统综述
summary: 系统综述 35 项研究，梳理 MRI 领域基础模型与视觉语言模型的方法、应用与落地障碍。
key_points: 纳入 35 项 MRI 基础模型与视觉语言模型研究
研究集中于神经影像，诊断分类最成熟
自动报告生成临床保真度不足
reason: 系统综述纳入 35 项研究、结论较清晰，但无原创数据，属综述上限档
abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] Artificial intelligence in medical imaging is shifting from task-specific algorithms toward adaptable foundation models (FMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). However, applying these models to MRI remains challenging because clinical interpretation requires integrating multi-parametric, volumetric imaging across multiple sequences with clinical context. This systematic review evaluates 35 studies on unimodal FMs and multimodal VLMs in MRI, summarizing emerging architectures, downstream applications, and challenges to clinical translation. Current research is concentrated in neuroimaging, with diagnostic classification representing the most mature application. Segmentation and outcome prediction also show promise, whereas automated report generation remains limited by poor clinical fidelity despite strong linguistic fluency. Broader adoption is hindered by heterogeneous MRI acquisition, limited large-scale paired image-text datasets, and inadequate safety-focused evaluation metrics. Advancing clinical translation will require standardized multicenter datasets, stronger integration with electronic health records and pathology, robust evaluation frameworks, and improved model explainability.
zh_abstract: [Cell reports. Medicine] 医学影像中的人工智能正从任务特定算法转向可适配的基础模型（FMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs）。然而，将这些模型应用于 MRI 仍具挑战，因为临床解读需要将跨多个序列的多参数、容积成像与临床背景相整合。本系统综述评估了 35 项关于 MRI 中单模态 FMs 和多模态 VLMs 的研究，总结新兴架构、下游应用及临床转化面临的挑战。当前研究集中在神经影像，诊断分类是最成熟的应用。分割和结局预测也显示出前景，而自动报告生成尽管语言流畅性强，仍受限于临床保真度差。更广泛采用受到 MRI 采集异质性、大规模配对图像-文本数据集有限以及以安全性为重点的评估指标不足所阻碍。推进临床转化将需要标准化的多中心数据集、与电子健康记录和病理学更强的整合、稳健的评估框架以及改进的模型可解释性。

title: The surgeon in the loop: automation bias and human-AI interaction in robotic surgery.
zh_title: 机器人手术中外科医生对AI提示的自动化偏差
summary: 19名外科医生在腹腔镜胆囊切除视频截图上作切口规划，对照有无AI叠加，量化对错误AI建议的采纳率。
key_points: 两阶段对照实验，19名外科医生参与
测量加入AI提示后切口规划的改动程度
统计错误AI建议被接受的比例
reason: 人机交互安全问题有新意，但样本仅19人、为模拟场景
abstract: [Surgical endoscopy] Artificial intelligence systems for intraoperative surgical guidance are approaching clinical deployment, yet no study has quantified automation bias (defined as the tendency to over-rely on automated recommendations) in the context of surgical decision-making. As these systems enter operative workflows, the surgeon's ability to recognize and override incorrect AI guidance becomes a critical safety requirement. To measure the extent to which surgeons modify incision plans after exposure to AI-labeled visual guidance and to determine the rate at which incorrect AI suggestions are accepted. A two-phase controlled experiment was conducted among 19 surgeons (10 residents, 2 fellows, 7 attendings). Participants drew incision lines on 20 static frames from robotic cholecystectomy videos, first without guidance (Phase 01) and then with a mock AI overlay (Phase 02). Overlays were either correct (derived from expert consensus) or deliberately incorrect (shifted toward unsafe anatomy) at an approximately 70:30 ratio. No actual AI model was used. The primary outcome was mean perpendicular distance (MPD) between Phase 01 and Phase 02 lines. Secondary outcomes included AI-corridor adherence, over-reliance and under-reliance rates, behavioral accuracy, and confidence shift. Across 231 paired observations, MPD did not differ significantly between correct (75.5 pixels; SD, 33.4) and incorrect (71.1 pixels; SD, 31.7) overlay conditions (P = .35). Directional analysis revealed that surgeons accepted incorrect AI suggestions in 60.6% of incorrect-overlay frames (43/71), with a specificity for rejecting incorrect guidance of only 39.4% (28/71). Correct suggestions were accepted 76.9% of the time (123/160). Overall behavioral accuracy was 65.4%. Self-reported confidence increased significantly after AI exposure (Δ = + 0.65; P < .001). Surgeons accepted approximately 3 of every 5 incorrect AI recommendations. As intraoperative AI systems approach deployment, surgeon oversight cannot be assumed to neutralize algorithmic error; it must be empirically measured, deliberately designed for, and prospectively validated.
zh_abstract: [Surgical endoscopy] 用于术中手术引导的人工智能系统正接近临床部署，但尚无研究量化手术决策背景下的自动化偏差（automation bias，定义为过度依赖自动推荐建议的倾向）。随着这些系统进入手术工作流程，外科医生识别并推翻错误 AI 引导的能力成为关键安全要求。测量外科医生在接触 AI 标记的视觉引导后修改切口计划的程度，并确定错误 AI 建议被接受的比例。在 19 名外科医生（10 名住院医师、2 名专科培训医师、7 名主治医师）中开展了一项两阶段对照实验。参与者在来自机器人胆囊切除术视频的 20 张静态帧上绘制切口线，首先无引导（第 01 阶段），然后使用模拟 AI 叠加层（第 02 阶段）。叠加层要么正确（源自专家共识），要么故意错误（向不安全解剖结构偏移），比例约为 70:30。未使用实际 AI 模型。主要结局是第 01 阶段与第 02 阶段线条之间的平均垂直距离（MPD）。次要结局包括 AI 走廊依从性、过度依赖和依赖不足率、行为准确性和信心变化。在 231 对配对观察中，正确（75.5 像素；SD，33.4）与错误（71.1 像素；SD，31.7）叠加条件下的 MPD 无显著差异（P = .35）。方向性分析显示，外科医生在 60.6% 的错误叠加帧中接受了错误 AI 建议（43/71），拒绝错误引导的特异性仅为 39.4%（28/71）。正确建议的接受率为 76.9%（123/160）。总体行为准确性为 65.4%。接触 AI 后自我报告信心显著增加（Δ = + 0.65；P < .001）。外科医生接受了每 5 条错误 AI 推荐中的约 3 条。随着术中 AI 系统接近部署，不能假定外科医生监督能够抵消算法错误；必须对其进行实证测量、有意设计并前瞻性验证。

title: Application of topological deep learning in staging liver fibrosis based on hepatobiliary phase MR images.
zh_title: 拓扑深度学习用于肝胆期MRI肝纤维化分期
summary: 回顾性研究构建融合拓扑数据分析与EfficientViT的模型，用于肝胆期MRI无创肝纤维化分期。
key_points: 构建TopoEfficientViT模型
回顾性纳入2018至2025年慢性肝病患者
以无创方式替代肝活检分期
reason: 同行评审回顾性影像研究，方法有新意但验证范围有限，属值得一看档
abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Early-stage liver fibrosis is reversible; thus, accurate staging of liver fibrosis is of great importance.. Liver biopsy is the gold standard for the diagnosis of liver fibrosis; however, its invasive nature limits its clinical application. Accurate noninvasive staging of liver fibrosis remains challenging. Thus, there is an urgent need for a precise and reliable noninvasive diagnostic approach. A topological deep learning model combining topological data analysis and EfficientViT framework (TopoEfficientViT) was developed to effectively capture global contextual relationships in hepatobiliary phase MR images for assessment of staging liver fibrosis. Our retrospective study included patients with chronic liver diseases from June 2018 to July 2025, which was approved by our Institutional Review Board. Our data from a hospital site (Site A) in our institution were divided into a training set (n = 275) and a validation set (n = 75). The test set (n=65) was composed of data from a separate hospital site (Site B) in the same institution. A total of 415 patients (323 males, mean age 56.52±9.54 years; 92 females, mean age 58.86±9.68 years) were enrolled in the study. In the training set, the AUC and accuracy of TopoEfficientViT for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.942 and 0.906, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.957 and 0.891, respectively. In the validation set, the AUC and accuracy for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.849 and 0.76, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.861and 0.813, respectively. In the test set, the AUC and accuracy for staging liver fibrosis F1-2 vs. F3-4 were 0.829 and 0.769, respectively; for staging liver fibrosis F1-3 vs. F4 were 0.791 and 0.785, respectively. The TopoEfficientViT model had high predictive performance for staging liver fibrosis by integrating multi-scale persistent homology topology with convolutional networks.

abstract: [Journal of imaging informatics in medicine] Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) remains essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease, while the focus has moved from stenosis to plaque burden. Current workflows either need manual adjustments that limit consistency and efficiency, or they lack segment-specific precision. This study evaluated the effectiveness and reliability of a fully automated deep learning-based plaque quantification method using CCTA. DVPlaque workflow, a fully automated deep learning model, was developed to quantify segment-specific plaque volume. A total of 271 CCTA scans were included. Plaque quantification was performed by the expert and DVPlaque model, respectively. Reliability was measured through interclass correlation coefficient (ICC) analysis and Bland-Altman plots. DVPlaque workflow cost less time than expert measurement (p 0.90, and per-segment ICCs were > 0.90 except for mid-LAD NCP (0.887). DVPlaque scheme was capable of quantifying plaque volume with excellent efficiency. The automated quantification of CP and NCP exhibited strong reliability even on a per-segment level, facilitating clinical application.

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Deep learning techniques in brain tumor analysis using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans have improved significantly, but their clinical deployment is limited by models with limited interpretability ('black-box' models) and data privacy limitations. This paper analyses recent literature and aims to explore the intersection of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) and Federated Learning (FL). Following the PRISMA protocol, a systematic search was conducted in Scopus on February 24, 2026, covering English-language journal articles and conference proceedings published from January 2020 to February 2026. The search initially identified 767 records, which were screened using predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria for MRI-based brain tumor studies addressing deep learning, explainability, privacy, or Federated Learning, resulting in 147 initially retained studies for the final screening set. One study was subsequently identified as formally retracted and excluded from the final synthesis, resulting in 146 included studies. The review classifies the literature into five primary research themes in brain tumor analysis: explainability, deep learning frameworks, privacy-preserving learning, advanced architectures (Transformers and Mamba), and multimodal learning. The literature suggests a paradigm shift in brain tumor analysis toward model interpretability using XAI. However, there is a significant knowledge gap in privacy-preserving collaborative learning models. Advanced architectures are proposed to solve brain tumor problems, but there are still limitations in model generalization, computational costs, and clinical reliability.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 使用磁共振成像（MRI）扫描进行脑肿瘤分析的深度学习技术已显著改进，但其临床部署受到可解释性有限（“黑箱”模型）和数据隐私限制的制约。本文分析近期文献，旨在探讨可解释人工智能（XAI）与联邦学习（FL）的交叉领域。遵循 PRISMA 方案，于 2026 年 2 月 24 日在 Scopus 进行了系统检索，覆盖 2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 2 月发表的英文期刊文章和会议论文。该检索初步识别 767 条记录，使用预定义纳入和排除标准筛选针对基于 MRI 的脑肿瘤研究、涉及深度学习、可解释性、隐私或联邦学习的研究，结果初步保留 147 项研究作为最终筛选集。随后一项研究被确认正式撤稿并从最终综合中排除，最终纳入 146 项研究。本综述将文献归类为脑肿瘤分析的五个主要研究主题：可解释性、深度学习框架、隐私保护学习、先进架构（Transformers 和 Mamba）以及多模态学习。文献提示脑肿瘤分析正朝向使用 XAI 的模型可解释性发生范式转变。然而，在隐私保护协作学习模型方面存在显著知识空白。先进架构被提出用于解决脑肿瘤问题，但在模型泛化、计算成本和临床可靠性方面仍存在局限。

abstract: [Molecular biology and evolution] During the evolution of protein sequences, amino acid substitutions follow broad patterns that are well established, such as those induced by the physico-chemical properties of residues or the position of sites along the sequence. While these deviations from random changes have been exploited for practical applications, such as to simulate protein evolution or to score protein alignments, they are too general to predict the precise evolution of individual protein sequences. To investigate whether protein sequences contain contextual information about their subsequent evolution beyond that captured by conventional substitution statistics and evolutionary conservation, we trained deep learning models based on an Evolutionary Scale Modelling (ESM2) encoder to predict the rate, the position and the nature of the amino-acid substitutions in the evolution of ancestral sequences and compared their performance to simpler and explainable heuristics. Our results show that predicting the rate of amino acid changes is achieved equally well by deep learning and by using evolutionary information in outgroup sequences. This suggests that the protein sequence does not contain information that significantly improves the predictions for this task. On the opposite, we show that deep learning models predict the position of these substitutions more accurately than statistics-based baselines. Predictions of the nature of substitutions largely outperform baselines, with over 37% accuracy overall. We observe that rapidly evolving sequences are harder to predict and substitutions preferentially occur between chemically similar amino acids. Interestingly, predictive information is predominantly contained within a local sequence context of 16 residues. These findings indicate that the nature of substitutions in protein evolution is partly governed by predictive rules that remain to be discovered through a more accurate modelling that could describe evolutionary trajectories based on sequence context alone.
zh_abstract: [Molecular biology and evolution] 在蛋白质序列的进化过程中，氨基酸替换遵循已被充分确立的广泛模式，例如由残基的物理化学性质或位点在序列中的位置所诱导的模式。尽管这些偏离随机变化的模式已被用于实际应用，例如模拟蛋白质进化或对蛋白质比对进行评分，但它们过于一般化，无法预测单个蛋白质序列的精确进化。为了研究蛋白质序列是否含有关于其后续进化的上下文信息——超出传统替换统计和进化保守性所捕获的信息——我们训练了基于进化尺度建模（Evolutionary Scale Modelling, ESM2）编码器的深度学习模型，以预测祖先序列进化中氨基酸替换的速率、位置和性质，并将其性能与更简单且可解释的启发式方法进行比较。我们的结果表明，预测氨基酸变化的速率，深度学习和使用外群序列中的进化信息可以达到同样好的效果。这表明蛋白质序列不包含能显著改善该任务预测的信息。相反，我们表明深度学习模型比基于统计的基线更准确地预测这些替换的位置。对替换性质的预测大大优于基线，总体准确率超过37%。我们观察到，快速进化的序列更难预测，并且替换优先发生在化学性质相似的氨基酸之间。有趣的是，预测信息主要包含在16个残基的局部序列上下文中。这些发现表明，蛋白质进化中替换的性质部分受尚待发现的预测规则支配，这些规则可通过更准确的建模来发现，而该建模或许能够仅基于序列上下文描述进化轨迹。

abstract: [iScience] Reliably estimating cerebral maturation in preterm newborns is crucial for early identification of atypical neurodevelopment. We developed a deep-learning framework using a convolutional neural network (CNN) to predict postmenstrual age (PMA) from spontaneous neural activity in EEG recordings of 165 healthy preterm infants (28-38 weeks PMA). The model achieved a mean absolute error of 0.75 ± 0.60 weeks, with 73.9% of prediction errors within one week. To identify key neurophysiological drivers, we systematically manipulated signal components. Results showed that removing low-frequency activity ( 12 Hz) had minimal impact. Our results demonstrate that maturation signatures are primarily driven by slow-wave dynamics and their hierarchical coupling with faster oscillations, which are fundamental hallmarks of early neurodevelopment.

abstract: [Zeitschrift fur medizinische Physik] PET image quality degradation due to positron range effects in high-energy positron-emitting radionuclides such as Gallium-68 (68Ga) can be mitigated by applying positron range correction (PRC). Deep learning (DL) models have been shown to improve image quality by reducing image noise. This study aimed to evaluate a DL model for simultaneous denoising and 68Ga-specific PRC in clinical [68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TOC PET scans. Three different U-Net-based DL models were trained to map reduced-count PET images reconstructed without PRC (25%, 33%, or 50% of acquired counts) to full-count PET images reconstructed with tissue-independent PRC (FC-PRC). The generated reduced-count-enhanced images (RCE-25%, RCE-33%, RCE-50%) were evaluated using the mean standardized uptake value (SUVmean) in liver and lung, noise levels in liver, and maximum standardized uptake value (SUVmax) and contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR) of soft tissue lesions. Three experienced nuclear medicine physicians assessed the overall image quality (OIQ), overall diagnostic confidence (ODC), and lesion detectability (sensitivity, specificity, accuracy). Compared to FC-PRC, RCE-33% and RCE-50% exhibited similar noise, whereas RCE-25% showed substantial residual noise. CNR was reduced for RCE-33% (-5.6%, p=0.001) and RCE-25% (-8.0%, p 90%). The proposed DL-based approach achieved comparable noise and image quality down to 50% of counts. Although it did not outperform the reconstruction-based PRC, its benefit lies in simultaneous denoising and PRC in a single step.
zh_abstract: [Zeitschrift fur medizinische Physik] 对于高能正电子发射放射性核素如镓-68（68Ga），正电子射程效应导致的PET图像质量下降可通过应用正电子射程校正（PRC）来减轻。深度学习（DL）模型已被证明可通过降低图像噪声来改善图像质量。本研究旨在评估一种DL模型，在临床[68Ga]Ga-DOTA-TOC PET扫描中同时进行去噪和68Ga特异性PRC。训练了三种不同的基于U-Net的DL模型，将未进行PRC重建的减少计数PET图像（采集计数的25%、33%或50%）映射到使用组织非依赖性PRC重建的全计数PET图像（FC-PRC）。生成的减少计数增强图像（RCE-25%、RCE-33%、RCE-50%）通过肝脏和肺的平均标准化摄取值（SUVmean）、肝脏噪声水平，以及软组织病灶的最大标准化摄取值（SUVmax）和对比噪声比（CNR）进行评估。三名经验丰富的核医学医师评估了整体图像质量（OIQ）、整体诊断信心（ODC）和病灶可检测性（敏感性、特异性、准确性）。与FC-PRC相比，RCE-33%和RCE-50%表现出相似的噪声，而RCE-25%显示出大量残留噪声。RCE-33%（-5.6%，p=0.001）和RCE-25%（-8.0%，p 90%）的CNR降低。所提出的基于DL的方法在低至50%计数时实现了相当的噪声和图像质量。尽管它未优于基于重建的PRC，但其优势在于单步骤中同时去噪和PRC。

abstract: [Psychopharmacology bulletin] Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) lacks approved pharmacological treatments despite a high symptom burden. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers new opportunities to accelerate drug discovery and model therapeutic effects. This study will outline an AI-enabled framework for identifying and modelling a novel pharmacological agent for BPD, designed to meet five therapeutic goals: (1) reduce depression without increasing impulsivity and suicidality, (2) reduce suicidality without sedation, (3) limit side effects and weight gain, (4) reduce polypharmacy, and (5) provide combined antidepressant, anti-suicidal, mood-stabilising, and antipsychotic effects. Three AI-driven approaches will be piloted: (1) deep-learning-based compound generation, (2) natural-language-processing (NLP) evidence synthesis, and (3) predictive modelling of symptom trajectories. These methods will be used to design and characterise a hypothetical multimodal compound, BPD-AI-01, including its predicted 3D molecular structure and receptor binding profile. All analyses will use publicly available data and in silico simulations. AI-guided modelling will generate BPD-AI-01, a candidate molecule predicted to act as a partial agonist at 5-HT1A receptors, a modulator at NMDA-associated sites, and a weak antagonist at 5-HT2A/D2 receptors, with low affinity for histaminergic and muscarinic receptors. Its 3D structure will be optimised to balance CNS penetration with reduced metabolic burden. Simulated trajectories will suggest potential antidepressant, anti-suicidal, mood-stabilising, and antipsychotic-like effects without marked sedation or weight gain. AI-enabled pharmacological research may support the design of next-generation medications for BPD that address multiple symptom domains within a single molecule. Empirical validation will be required before any clinical application.

abstract: [Journal of integrative neuroscience] Alzheimer's disease (AD) progresses slowly through several stages until the patient reaches full cognitive decline. The electroencephalography (EEG) alterations associated with AD often emerge before symptom onset, suggesting that accessible and repeated EEG-based assessment could facilitate earlier detection and longitudinal monitoring. However, this type of assessment requires an AD detection model operating on edge-computing platforms within the Internet of Medical Things (IoMT). At present, many existing AD detection models rely on complex deep learning architectures with numerous parameters, which significantly limit their practicality for on-edge deployment. We propose an on-edge AD detection framework comprising a lightweight dilated hybrid deep learning (DHDL) model with a channel selection approach to reduce the computational and power demands on the evaluated edge-computing platform. A key architectural component is the inclusion of dual-granularity dilated temporal convolutions. This method expands the receptive field at two scales to capture both short- and long-term temporal features from EEG signals without increasing the number of parameters. Subsequently, several hybrid lightweight layers extract distinct temporal and spatial features and are integrated with attention mechanisms. abstract: [Frontiers in ophthalmology] Glaucoma is among the leading causes of blindness. It is important to detect glaucoma at early stages. Using structural and functional examinations to identify primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) is critical. Computer-aided diagnosis of glaucoma requires multimodal data to identify an accurate and explainable model for early glaucoma diagnosis. In this study, 301 multimodal data points were collected from the ophthalmology department at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University. Data regarding fundus photography (FP), retinal nerve fiber layer thickness (RNFLt), intraocular pressure (IOP) values, visual field examination parameters and age were obtained. The algorithm delivers superior results in the early diagnosis of POAG. This study's hybrid deep learning-machine learning framework can effectively assist with clinical decision-making for early POAG.

abstract: [Journal of the Egyptian National Cancer Institute] Cancer stem cells (CSCs) are a major contributor to therapeutic resistance, tumour recurrence, and disease progression because of their self-renewal capacity, phenotypic plasticity, immune evasion, and ability to persist after treatment. Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-based immunotherapy has transformed the treatment of several hematological malignancies, but effective targeting of CSC-driven disease, especially solid tumour, remains challenging. Antigen heterogeneity and loss, CSC plasticity, CAR-cell dysfunction, metabolic constraints, and an immunosuppressive tumour microenvironment (TME) can limit long-term therapeutic responses. CSC-associated antigens such as CD133, CD44, EpCAM, HER2, CSPG4, ALDH, and EGFRvIII have been investigated as CAR targets, although their heterogeneous and context-dependent expression raises important concerns regarding CSC specificity and on-target/off-tumour toxicity. Artificial intelligence (AI) and computational approaches provide opportunities to integrate genomic, transcriptomic, proteomic, spatial, and clinical data for CSC-associated antigen discovery, biomarker identification, CAR design, patient stratification, and toxicity prediction. However, the evidence supporting these applications varies considerably, ranging from computational and preclinical studies to retrospective clinical modelling, while prospective clinical validation of AI-guided CSC-targeted CAR therapy remains limited. Similarly, next-generation platforms, including CAR-natural killer (CAR-NK) cells, CAR-macrophages (CAR-M), gamma-delta CAR-T cells, and CAR-invariant natural killer T (CAR-iNKT) cells, remain at different stages of translational development. This review critically examines CSC biology, mechanisms of resistance to CAR-based therapy, emerging CAR platforms, and the potential role of AI in precision immunogenetics. Particular emphasis is placed on differentiating CSC-intrinsic, CAR-cell-intrinsic, and TME-mediated resistance and on defining the evidence maturity of AI applications. Finally, current challenges in data availability, tumour heterogeneity, model bias, external validation, interpretability, safety, and prospective clinical translation are discussed, together with priorities for developing clinically validated AI-enabled CSC-targeted CAR therapies.
